channel.title: MyStat stable updates
channel.description: Stable releases for Apple Silicon on macOS 26 and 27.

item.title: MyStat 0.2.0
item.description:
MyStat 0.2.0 keeps the menu-bar meter a fixed width across single-, double-, and triple-digit readings, paused monitoring, and unavailable sensors. Numeric values are right-aligned so the percent signs and neighboring menu-bar icons stay put. Labels and pause/unavailable symbols are centered within their columns. The dashboard now adapts its height and position when the display changes.
This release is signed with Apple Developer ID, notarized by Apple, and includes a stapled notarization ticket. Sparkle continues to verify the existing Ed25519 signatures on updates. Automatic update checks remain off by default; there is no telemetry or privileged helper.
Built and tested for Apple Silicon on macOS 26. macOS 27 sensor mappings remain experimental. Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
